newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Tourvest to list, sees earnings rise.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Tourvest to list, sees earnings rise.

text.p: South African tourism company Tourism Investment Corporation Ltd said it would list on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange at the start of business on Monday.
The group, which is involved in tourism and travel services and sells tourism merchandise, will list 330 million shares of one cent each under the Beverages, Hotels and Leisure sector of the JSE.
The company forecast earnings per share of 4.0 cents in the year to June 1997, rising to 5.5 cents in the year to June 1998.
It expected to declare a dividend of 2.0 cents in the year to June 1997 and 2.8 cents in the year to June 1998.
